audit.why: Even skill lane through level 3, Morgana takes over at 4-6 and first item once burst outpaces her heal, Soraka pulls back ahead late once stacked heals plus global Wish out-sustain the poke — chart, whys, and phases all agree already.

Level 6 global Wish forcing a burst-through-heal all-in, first item widening the Q+W poke lead, and late stacked heals overtaking Morgana's poke are already the spikes and are grounded in the kit (R cd 150/135/120, no cast range limit).
